turns.user_query: 查一下各个学校的各科成绩
turns.final_sql: SELECT T1.School, T2.AvgScrMath, T2.AvgScrWrite, T2.AvgScrRead FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds ORDER BY T2.AvgScrMath DESC

turns.user_query: 列出每个学校的名称和平均阅读成绩
turns.final_sql: SELECT T1.School, AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read_score FROM schools AS T1 JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds GROUP BY T1.School ORDER BY avg_read_score DESC
